title: GS1 Rail Vocabulary
usedFor: Nothing today. Recorded because it was found alongside the others and because rail rolling stock carries batteries, which is the only route by which it could become relevant.
finding: Out of scope. We model no rail product group and none is announced. Its sensor-metadata and EPCIS-registry shapes are the part that could matter later, since Battery Regulation Annex VII state-of-health parameters are sensor-shaped, but that is a reason to remember it exists, not to map to it.
nextStep: None. Revisit only if a rail or rolling-stock product group is announced, or if the Annex VII parameter-set modelling wants an existing sensor vocabulary rather than a new one.
